2608.03729.title: GPTKB 2.0: Direct Construction of Disambiguated Knowledge Bases from Large Language Models
2608.03729.paper_summary: Automated Knowledge Base Construction (AKBC) is a core NLP task, and recent work proposes generating knowledge bases directly from large language models (LLMs), treating the model itself as the knowledge source. However, LLMs natively possess no representation of entities, leading to duplicate entries as well as conflations. We propose GPTKB 2.0, a methodology for constructing disambiguated KBs directly from LLMs. GPTKB 2.0 incorporates on-the-fly disambiguation of entities, relations and classes, and is meticulously designed to satisfy both scalability and disambiguation accuracy. We analyze the central design decisions and characterize the trade-offs between accuracy, scale, and cost. We execute GPTKB 2.0 at scale, obtaining a materialized KB containing over 1M disambiguated entities and 38.4M triples. This represents the first million-scale LLM-native KB with explicit internal canonicalization of entities, relations, and classes, a significant departure from prior Wikimedia-centric works. GPTKB 2.0 is available at https://gptkb.org/.
2608.03729.paper_summary_zh: 自動化知識庫建構 (AKBC) 是一項核心的自然語言處理任務，近期的研究提出直接從大型語言模型 (LLMs) 生成知識庫，將模型本身視為知識來源。然而，LLMs 原生並不具備實體的表示，導致重複條目以及混淆。我們提出 GPTKB 2.0，一種直接從 LLMs 構建消歧義知識庫的方法。GPTKB 2.0 具備即時消歧義實體、關係和類別的能力，並精心設計以滿足可擴展性和消歧義準確性的要求。我們分析了中心設計決策並描述了準確性、規模和成本之間的權衡。我們以大規模執行 GPTKB 2.0，獲得了一個包含超過 100 萬個消歧義實體和 3840 萬個三元組的具體化知識庫。這代表著首個百萬規模的 LLM 原生知識庫，具有明確的內部標準化實體、關係和類別，這是對先前以維基媒體為中心的工作的重大突破。GPTKB 2.0 可在 https://gptkb.org/ 獲得。
